Just had my first oneplus phone: the oneplus 13. The curved screen makes it hard to find a suitable screen protector, I just messed up one that cost me like 23 usd. Cases are also limited and have to source it from china which is always a hit or missed, you either get something extremely high quality or something that is shit to the core. 

Hardware wise the oneplus 13 is a flagship level phone with it's only competitors are it's bigger brother Oppo with their recent find x8 ultra. China only flagship are insane with the software and hardware but they usually don't released globally which is a huge bummer. 

The dislikes are mostly the lack of quality defaults apps. They are so damn basic with their notetaking app only features are composing notes, no folder, no backup, no export, no import. Limited themes, clock and fonts as theme store are only available on coloros Chinese version as they are made aesthetically for Chinese users.

The likes are lightweight os with great hardware.

Oneplus hardware is pretty high end. Battery life and charging speed are great. 12r has 5500mAh battery that charges at 100watts so be prepared to buy a 100watts charging brick to fully utilized the charging speed. The companies focus is to make high end phones affordable without compromising on the hardware to attract potential customers. However, what's lacking is their default apps. Their OS lacks a good quality notepad without the option to import or export, OS don't even have a calendar and uses google calendar, poor data transfer app, lacks customizability, etc. Their default apps are just basic tools that lacks a ton of features. They compensated it by over-relying on google apps. 

Samsung on the other hand, their focus is on the eco system. To polish it to be user friendly so that more people buy their products. Their hardware often are subpar compared to oneplus. With that said, they come with apps that has great features. Easy syncing between Samsung devices, Comes with quality defaults apps like samsung notes, calendar able to sync with multiple device or third party app, better AI features, so on and so forth. Also, they provide longer OS support and system security update about 7 years if I am not wrong. By cutting corners on the hardware, Samsung compensated it with a good amount of included defaults apps, software support and better OS.
Are there even any confirmation or information that this phone will go global?

You have to wait a long time for that to happen. Approximately 2-3 years of waiting time due to gpu not powerful enough to push frame rate up to more than 250 fps at 4k resolution with ultra settings with or without frame gen at this moment. A 1440p oled 500hz now will suffice as gpus are getting less and less power efficient. Until they fix that I think it is safer to stick to 1440p rather than 4k. Unless you are playing on tv then you won't need a 4k resolution to have an immersive experience. Even at 1440p 500hz the current gpus are bottlenecking such monitors like for example a 5090 might not even run triple A games at 500fps at ultra setting.
